articles.title: Installing and Configuring NixOS: A Practical Beginner’s Guide
articles.description: Introduces the basics of installing and configuring NixOS, covering declarative package management, reproducible development environments, PostgreSQL configuration, and system generations.

articles.title: Vector Search with Faiss, cuVS, CuPy and NVIDIA Nsight Optimization
articles.description: Explores performance trade-offs between GPU vector search approaches, with practical optimization strategies and insights derived from NVIDIA Nsight Systems profiling.

articles.title: Six Hats of Thinking and Design Thinking Techniques
articles.description: Shows how structured creative processes can break through common innovation obstacles and how to apply design thinking techniques to improve user focus and solution quality.

articles.title: Exploring What Is Creativity Through Tina Seelig’s Innovation Engine
articles.description: Breaks down Tina Seelig’s Innovation Engine to explain how creativity emerges from the interplay of mindset and environment, enriched with practical insights from research on divergent thinking and active listening.

articles.title: Igra obkoljevanja
articles.description: Examines the game of Go beyond its rules, interpreting it as a space of self-reflection and control, and connecting its strategic logic to philosophical ideas and modern AI systems that analyze and predict human behavior.

articles.title: On Lucretius’ Theory of Simulacra
articles.description: Reinterprets Lucretius’ theory of simulacra to show how perception is shaped by continuous material processes, arguing that imposed mental categories can limit our ability to perceive and think creatively.

articles.title: Irwinove pozne črte
articles.description: Illustrates how creative work arises from breaking habitual patterns and engaging with uncertainty, linking Robert Irwin’s practice of attentive observation to Deleuze and Guattari’s theory of desiring-machines.
